segments.headline: A fair test for robot AI

beats.narration: In a demo video, every robot looks good. So how does robot AI do in a fair test on real robots?
Labs and companies ran blind tests on real robots in many places.
Like a taste test: two unnamed AIs try the same task, and a judge picks the better one.
The finding: every system struggled to finish real-world tasks reliably.

visual.sub: to finish real-world tasks reliably · the paper

beats.narration: On the humanoid robot, no AI finished a single task.
Why it matters: every run, failures included, is published for others to study.
But it's an early paper, and the organizers ran the tests.
